description: Lightweight rubric for classifying whether a document belongs to the supported subject whitelist.
classification_checks: Use only the visible extracted content.
Check whether the material belongs to exactly one supported subject area.
Reject content that is clearly outside the whitelist.
Return ambiguous when the content is too short, too noisy, or mixes multiple supported subject areas.
Do not infer from filename alone if topic evidence is weak.
acceptance_rule: Return supported only when there is clear evidence for exactly one supported subject.
ambiguity_rule: Return ambiguous when evidence is insufficient or mixed.
rejection_rule: Return unsupported when the content is outside the supported subject whitelist.
